text: 黄庭坚说，“男儿四十未全老，便入林泉真自豪。
en: Tingjian Huang said, "A man at forty is not yet wholly old; to retire to the forest and springs is truly a source of pride.

text: 一、黄庭坚其人
en: I. Tingjian Huang the Man

text: 黄庭坚，即是赫赫有名的黄山谷。
en: Tingjian Huang is none other than the renowned Shangu Huang.

text: 在看唐浩明版曾国藩的时候，书中经常提及两个人，一个是王船山，另一个就是黄山谷，都是曾国藩这个“近代第一完人”的偶像。
en: When reading the edition of Guofan Zeng by Haoming Tang, the book frequently mentions two people, one being Chuanshan Wang and the other Shangu Huang, both idols of Guofan Zeng, this 'most perfect man of the modern era'.

text: 王船山就是王夫之，与顾炎武、黄宗羲一同被誉为明清之际的三大思想家。
en: Chuanshan Wang was in fact Fuzhi Wang, who, together with Yanwu Gu and Zongxi Huang, was acclaimed as the three great thinkers of the Ming–Qing transition.

text: 那么与之同为曾国藩偶像的黄庭坚，又是一个什么样的人呢？
en: Then what sort of person was Tingjian Huang, who was likewise an idol of Guofan Zeng?

text: 黄庭坚，广为人知的是“苏门四学士”之一，中过进士，当过县官、知州、别驾、安置等官，秉性刚直，直言无讳，得罪同僚及上官，如苏轼一般被各处贬谪。
en: Tingjian Huang is widely known as one of the 'Four Scholars of the Su Gate'; he passed the imperial examination and served as a county magistrate, a prefect, an assistant prefect, an exile supervisor and other offices. Of an upright and unyielding nature, outspoken without reserve, he offended colleagues and superiors, and like Shi Su was banished to various posts.

text: 他事母至孝、诗书双绝，影响了有宋一代诗风。
en: He served his mother with the utmost filial piety, excelled in both poetry and calligraphy, and shaped the poetic style of the whole Song dynasty.

text: 二、有趣的人，有趣的诗
en: II. An Interesting Man, Interesting Poetry

text: 《答龙门潘秀才见寄》是一首赠诗，也是一首唱和诗，更是一首田园诗，全文如下：
en: 'Reply to Scholar Pan of Longmen, Who Sent Me a Poem' is a dedicatory poem, also a responsive poem, and moreover a pastoral poem; the full text is as follows:

text: 男儿四十未全老，便入林泉真自豪。
en: A man at forty is not yet wholly old; to retire to the forest and springs is truly a source of pride.

text: 明月清风非俗物，轻裘肥马谢儿曹。
en: The bright moon and fresh breeze are no vulgar things; fine furs and fat horses I leave to the young.

text: 山中是处有黄菊，洛下谁家无白醪。
en: In the mountains, yellow chrysanthemums grow everywhere; below Luo, which household lacks white wine?

text: 想得秋来常日醉，伊川清浅石楼高。
en: I imagine that when autumn comes he is drunk day after day, by the clear, shallow Yichuan, where the stone tower stands high.

text: 从古以来，男人四十是成家立业、中流砥柱的最好年华。
en: Since ancient times, forty has been a man's finest age to settle down, build a career, and be a mainstay of society.

text: 然而这位潘秀才，却独树一帜，在四十的中年归隐田园，寄情山水，令人称奇。
en: Yet this Scholar Pan stood apart, retiring to the countryside at the middle age of forty and finding solace in mountains and rivers, which is truly remarkable.

text: 首联直抒胸臆，对秀才的归隐给予正面认可，认为归隐同样是大丈夫所谓，真自豪，有生豪气的意思，令人想起李白的“意气素霓生”。
en: The opening couplet speaks straight from the heart, giving positive recognition to the scholar's retirement and holding that retirement is likewise what a true man does — 'truly a source of pride', with a sense of born heroism — which calls to mind Bai Li's line, 'his valour born of the white rainbow'.

text: 颔联给出了解释，为何说归隐同样是大丈夫所为？
en: The second couplet offers an explanation of why retirement is likewise the deed of a true man.

text: 因为清风明月之内，并非俗物，不是大丈夫不足以感受到其中的真味道，所谓陶渊明的“此中有真意”，同时，还令人联想到苏东坡的“惟江上之清风，与山间之明月，耳得之而为声，目遇之而成色，取之无禁，用之不竭，是造物者之无尽藏也，而吾与子之所共适。
en: For within the fresh breeze and bright moon there is nothing vulgar; none but a true man is sufficient to sense their true flavour — as Yuanming Tao put it, 'within this there is true meaning' — and it also brings to mind Dongpo Su's words: "only the fresh breeze above the river and the bright moon among the hills; the ear catches it and it becomes sound, the eye meets it and it becomes colour; take it without prohibition, use it without exhaustion — it is the Creator's inexhaustible treasury, shared by you and me.

text: 至于肥马轻裘，自然是代表功名利禄，这些东西也不错，所谓的出世入世两条路嘛。
en: As for fat horses and fine furs, they naturally stand for fame, rank, and wealth; these things are not bad either — the so-called two roads of withdrawal from and engagement with the world.

text: 虽然我不认同，不选择，但我也不在意将入世当官的好事让给那些年轻人来做。
en: Although I do not agree with it or choose it, I do not mind leaving the good fortune of engaging with the world and holding office to those young people.

text: 后四句写隐居生活的好处，有山有水，山中有菊花摇曳，水边人家有村酒，可谋一醉。
en: The last four lines write of the pleasures of a reclusive life: there are hills and waters, chrysanthemums sway in the mountains, and by the waterside homes there is village wine, enough to seek a drunken repose.

text: 没事儿喝点小酒，看看水，看看山，看看石楼，看看风景，多么惬意的人生。
en: With nothing to do, drink a little wine, look at the water, look at the hills, look at the stone tower, look at the scenery — what a pleasant life.

text: 你能说这样的人生不好吗？
en: Can you say such a life is not good?

text: 三、出世和入世，退后一步是向前
en: III. Withdrawal from and Engagement with the World: A Step Back Is a Step Forward

text: 从古至今，读书人都有两条路，一条是读书入世，另一条是读书出世。
en: From ancient times to now, scholars have had two paths: one is to study and engage with the world, the other is to study and withdraw from it.

text: 入世的，追求功名利禄，光耀门楣，乃至为民造福，最终名垂史册。
en: Those who engage with the world pursue fame, rank, and wealth, bring glory to their family, and even benefit the people, ultimately leaving a name in the annals of history.

text: 出世的，学儒释道，入山唯恐不深，一心唯恐不静。
en: Those who withdraw from the world study Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism, fearing only that their retreat into the mountains is not deep enough and that their single-mindedness is not still enough.

text: 入世和出世哪个更好？
en: Which is better, engaging with the world or withdrawing from it?

text: 我以为并无高下。
en: In my view, there is no superiority or inferiority between them.

text: 入世是修身，难道不也是修心？
en: To engage with the world is to cultivate one's character — is it not also to cultivate one's mind?

text: 出世是修心，其实也是在修身。
en: To withdraw from the world is to cultivate one's mind, but in truth it is also cultivating one's character.

text: 想到那句有趣的对联：“道不行，乘桴浮于海；人之患，冠冕立于朝。
en: I am reminded of that interesting couplet: "If the way does not prevail, I shall float on a raft upon the sea; the trouble with men is that they stand in court with caps and crowns.

text: ”如果一切顺利，吾道不孤，那就逞胸中才，为民谋福利；如果不受认可，处处碰壁，那就退隐林泉，不要自我纠结、宁死不去，那岂不是面子里子都丢了？
en: ”If all goes smoothly and I am not alone in my cause, then I shall display the talent in my breast and seek the welfare of the people; if I meet no recognition and am rebuffed at every turn, then I shall retire to the forest and springs — do not torment yourself, refusing to leave even unto death, for would that not lose both face and substance?

text: 人到四十岁，四十不惑，当明白“退后一步是向前”的上述道理。
en: A person reaching forty — at forty one is free of doubts — should understand the above principle that 'a step back is a step forward'.

text: “6月1日48岁网红段煜突发脑溢血，昏迷25天去世”；
en: "On 1 June, the 48-year-old internet celebrity Yu Duan suddenly suffered a cerebral haemorrhage and, after 25 days in a coma, passed away";

text: 就会惊觉:48岁离脑溢血这么近了？
en: one is startled: is forty-eight really so close to cerebral haemorrhage?

text: 40岁出头，女，每天都想要离职，每天都充满干劲。
en: Just past forty, female, wanting to quit every day, yet full of drive every day.

text: 就是这么神奇的状态，有房贷，上有老下有小。
en: Such a marvellous state it is — with a mortgage, with elders above and children below.

text: 每天都想着让生活走上正轨，每天都距离正轨有距离。
en: Every day I think about putting life back on track, yet every day I remain at a distance from that track.

text: 办起事来和社牛一样，没皮没脸不达目标不罢休，但是讲到自己的问题就是社恐，像蜗牛一样畏手畏脚。
en: When it comes to getting things done I am like a 'social bull' — shameless and relentless until the goal is reached; but when it comes to my own problems I become socially anxious, shrinking back like a snail.

text: 总是很委屈，很被背刺。
en: Always feeling wronged, always being stabbed in the back.

text: 40岁，还是很有梦想，企图安排好一切，再为自己活一次。
en: At forty, still full of dreams, attempting to arrange everything, to live for myself one more time.

text: 是不是还是很幼稚呢？
en: Is this still rather naive?

text: 40岁左右的中年人，生活上的体会，我感觉挺好的。
en: As for the life experience of those around forty, I feel it is quite good.

text: 人们不是为了经常显得自己有压力，会说一句话叫上有老下有小。
en: People do not say the phrase 'elders above and children below' merely to show that they are under pressure.

text: 实际上对于很多人来讲，有的人上没有老下没有小，跟这些人相比的话，上有老下有小是一个多么幸福的事情。
en: In truth, for many people, some have no elders above and no children below; compared with such people, having elders above and children below is such a blessed thing.

text: 上面父母安在下面，儿女健康活泼，这是多么幸福的人生，所谓的天伦之乐也不过如此。
en: Parents above are safe and well, children below are healthy and lively — what a happy life this is; the so-called joy of family ties is no more than this.

text: 但从工作和经济上来讲上有老，需要赡养，每个月要给钱，下有小需要上学需要成长，还要花钱，所以说经济上的压力可能是大的。
en: But in terms of work and finances, having elders above means they need support and money must be given every month; having children below means they need schooling and growth, and more money besides — so the financial pressure may well be great.

text: 但是反过来，人到了40岁左右的时候，从20岁开始走上社会，懵懵懂懂，磕磕绊绊，走过了20多年，时间实际上也到了一个人有了比较好的人生经历，人生的阅历，朋友圈，关系网，资源最为丰富，最为能有效利用的阶段。
en: But on the other hand, when a person reaches around forty, having entered society at twenty, confused and stumbling, and passed through more than twenty years, the time has in fact arrived at the stage where one has the richest and most usable life experience, worldly wisdom, circle of friends, network of connections, and resources.

text: 所以大多数人到了40岁左右，面临着要么跳槽，要么创业，要么被开除，的艰难的抉择是因为自己没有做好一个提前和充分的准备。
en: Therefore most people reaching around forty face the difficult choice of either changing jobs, starting a business, or being dismissed, and the reason is that they have not made early and adequate preparation.

text: 没有对自己的人生经历人生的过往，你走过的路你得到的和你失去的，并没有做好一个复盘和盘点，所以你并不知道人到了40岁应该如何借助和利用你之前的资源，让自己不再这么迷茫。
en: They have not reviewed and taken stock of their life experience and past — the roads you have walked, what you have gained and lost — so you do not know how, at forty, to draw upon and make use of your earlier resources, so as to stop being so lost.

text: 所以呀，人到了40岁，首先应该做的是做一个好好的复盘和盘点你有什么？
en: So then, when a person reaches forty, the first thing to do is a proper review and stocktaking of what you have?

text: 你没有什么你可以利用什么？
en: What do you lack, and what can you make use of?

text: 你想做什么？
en: What do you want to do?

text: 我觉得凡事预则立不预则，费曼研究，快决策，高效执行，人声跟企业是一样的，加油吧。
en: I hold that in all matters, planning ensures success while failing to plan ensures failure; the Feynman technique, quick decisions, efficient execution — people are the same as enterprises. Keep going.

text: 人生体会就是，不想放弃又达不到自己的目标的煎熬。
en: The experience of life is the torment of not wanting to give up yet being unable to reach one's goals.

text: 少年时总是意气风发，到中年才明白事事难如意，想做的跟自己能做的总是有一段鸿沟，也会茫然。
en: In youth one is always high-spirited; only in middle age does one understand that nothing goes as wished, that there is always a chasm between what one wants to do and what one can do, and one is left bewildered.

text: 也会看淡很多事情，以前耿耿于怀的事情，现在可能沉默而已。
en: One also learns to take many things lightly; matters one once brooded over may now be met with silence.

text: 不是社会变化太快，只是自己跟不上。
en: It is not that society changes too fast, only that one cannot keep up.

text: 两个字：无奈，三个字：很无奈，这个社会对中年人一点也不友好，很多的企业宁可给刚毕业的年轻人开高薪也不愿意稍低的工资招有经验的中年人，
en: Two words: helpless; three words: very helpless. This society is not at all kind to the middle-aged; many enterprises would rather offer high salaries to fresh graduates than hire experienced middle-aged people at a slightly lower wage,

text: 原因无非有以下几点，一是感觉中年人不好管理，因为他们经历过很多事情之后有自己的想法和看法，这本身就是管理层的愚民政策；二是认为中年人上有老下有小，
en: the reasons are nothing more than the following. First, they feel the middle-aged are hard to manage, because having been through much they have their own thoughts and views — which in itself is the management's policy of keeping people ignorant; second, they believe the middle-aged have elders above and children below,

text: 家庭压力大，个人工作也没激情了，加不了班，不好压榨和剥削了，三是大环境问题，每年有这么多的新鲜血液都用不完，优先考虑年轻人。
en: their family pressures are great, they have lost their passion for work, cannot do overtime, and are no longer easy to exploit and squeeze; third, it is a matter of the macro environment — with so much fresh blood each year that it cannot all be used, young people are given priority.

text: 造成以上这个现状的原因还是跟大环境有关，主要是我们这么多人口的国家，政府和私人企业提供的岗位远远不够，大家可以想象一下，干个体的很多都是被迫无奈才做点小生意，如果有交社保的上班工作我相信他们肯定会选择上班，看看发达国家，很多的岗位都是中年人在做，空姐空乘，服务员等等职位，而我们清一色的年轻人，这个社会对中年人太不友好了，中年失业是非常痛苦的经历，痛苦到会强烈的怀疑人生，会全盘否定以前的经历。
en: The cause of the above situation still relates to the macro environment. Mainly, in our country with so large a population, the posts provided by government and private enterprises fall far short of what is needed. Just imagine: many who work for themselves do so only because they are forced and helpless into a small business; if there were office jobs with social insurance, I believe they would certainly choose employment. Look at developed countries, where many posts — flight attendants, waiters, and so on — are filled by the middle-aged, whereas ours are uniformly the young. This society is too unkind to the middle-aged; middle-aged unemployment is a most painful experience, so painful as to make one strongly doubt life and wholly deny one's past.
